comment: Mapped model species to canonical molecular entities using common gene/protein names and common synonyms. Activation/inactivation/phospho/degraded states were mapped to the base protein where appropriate. Process-like or state species that do not correspond to a single molecule (DNA_damage, Autophagy states) were labeled as unknown. The single physical complex in the model (PP2A_I2PP2A) was decomposed into its protein components (PP2A and SET/I2PP2A).
